description: The AI Assistant provides intelligent chat functionality within the application, offering contextual help, navigation guidance, and support for various tasks. It can preview relevant entities and adapt its assistance based on your current context.

pages.name: AiContentComponent
pages.description: This component integrates the AI Assistant directly into the main application view, providing a seamless chat experience. It offers AI chat capabilities, displays relevant entity previews, and delivers context-aware assistance to help you navigate and utilize the application effectively.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure how to proceed, simply type your question into the chat input field. The AI is designed to assist you with navigating the application, understanding its features, finding specific data, or performing various tasks. You can review past conversations by clicking the chat history button, usually located in the top bar.
common_tasks: Getting help: Ask questions about how to use specific features or find information within the application.
Entity assistance: Inquire about partners, contacts, or interactions to receive contextual help related to your current work.
Navigation help: Get guidance on where to locate specific features, pages, or data within the application.
Task automation: Request assistance with complex workflows or data entry processes to streamline your work.

pages.name: AiLayoutComponent
pages.description: This is the dedicated full-screen interface for the AI Assistant, offering comprehensive tools for managing chat sessions, utilizing smart sidebars for context, and receiving intelligent assistance. It provides a robust environment for all your AI support needs, helping you efficiently navigate and use the application.

help_guidance.when_stuck: To begin, type your question into the chat input field. The AI can assist you with navigating the application, understanding its features, finding data, or performing tasks. Use the sidebar to manage your chat sessions, search through previous conversations, or view entity previews. For an expanded view, click the fullscreen icon.
common_tasks: Getting help: Ask questions about how to use specific features or find information within the application.
Managing sessions: Create new chat conversations, rename existing sessions for better organization, or search through your chat history.
Entity assistance: Inquire about partners, contacts, or interactions to receive contextual help related to your current work.
Navigation help: Get guidance on where to locate specific features, pages, or data within the application.
Task automation: Request assistance with complex workflows or data entry processes to streamline your work.
